about: The painter, the game's avatar (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md §22): the old master painter in a felt beret, candidate A of the third round, chosen by the owner on 2026-10-24. Pictures rendered in Blender from the assets below; the scripts that pose, dress and render him stay outside the repository (out/avatar-final/src, out/avatar3/src). The pictures here are the sources, under the render's own names; the game carries copies of them in unity/Assets/Art/Avatar/Resources/Painter under the English names of "inGame" (the game's code speaks English), imported for the phone by unity/Assets/Editor/AvatarArtImport.cs. credits.md beside this file is the render agent's own credit note, kept as written.

madeWith.toolLicence: GPL; pictures made with Blender belong to the user, the GPL does not extend to them
madeWith.notes: No person was drawn or sculpted by hand: pose, clothes, light and rendering by script; the expressions are set with the Einar rig's own face controls.

pictures.use: the hall, standing beside the workbench: palette in the left hand, brush raised in the right
the hall of a new player who has won no level yet: the same place, waving
a painting made whole (beside the jigsaw's tray) and a room restored (in its hall): both arms raised
the bust that guides: beside the tutorial's and the booster intro's words
the bust that thinks: beside the words of a step that shows something new to work out (crates, varnish, tape, frame corners, the long press)
the joyful bust: on a won level's card, and beside the words of the first painting made whole

sources.modified: Only the head, hair, beard, brows, eyes, mouth and the sweater's roll-neck are used; hair and beard turned silver, the film's stray-hair layers and grime and bruise maps turned down, skin desaturated, roll-neck made plain navy, expressions set with the rig's own face controls, head placed on another body; beret, apron, palette and brush added.

It shows each creditLine above and the MIT text exactly as written here, in English in every language; the tests hold the game's lines (unity/Assets/Scripts/Flow/CreditWords.cs) to this file.
